title: Slack Block Kit
description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for Slack Block Kit payloads. Validates a top-level array of blocks. Individual block, element, and composition object schemas are exposed via $defs for re-use. Compiled from https://docs.slack.dev/reference/block-kit (fetched 2026-04-16). Surface restrictions (messages vs modals vs home) and payload-level rules (e.g. cumulative 12k char markdown limit, single-table-per-message, max two data-visualization blocks per message) are documented in $defs descriptions but not enforced at the per-block level.

action_id.description: An identifier for the interactive element. Should be unique among all action_ids used in a single view/message.

block_id.description: A unique identifier for a block. Should be unique within a single message or view.

text_object.description: A text object — either plain_text or mrkdwn.

text.description: Per Slack docs examples, this field accepts plain_text OR mrkdwn. Prose on the docs page says plain_text, but the example payload uses mrkdwn.

option_object_plain_text.description: Option object used in select / multi-select menus. text and description must be plain_text. url is not allowed here (overflow only).

option_object_overflow.description: Option object used in overflow menus. Adds optional url field.

option_object_radio_or_checkbox.description: Option object used in radio_buttons and checkboxes elements. text and description may be plain_text or mrkdwn.

slack_file_object.description: Reference to a Slack file. Exactly one of url or id must be provided. Supported file types: png, jpg, jpeg, gif.

conversation_filter_object.description: Filter object for conversations_select / multi_conversations_select. At least one of include / exclude_external_shared_channels / exclude_bot_users must be present.

placeholder_object.description: Reusable placeholder text object (plain_text only, max 150 chars).

icon_button_element.description: Icon button — only valid inside a context_actions block.

email_input_element.description: Must be used inside an input block.

url_input_element.description: Must be used inside an input block.

number_input_element.description: Must be used inside an input block. min_value must not exceed max_value.

plain_text_input_element.description: Must be used inside an input block.

feedback_buttons_element.description: Must be used inside a context_actions block.

conversations_select_element.description: response_url_enabled is only valid when used inside an input block within a modal.

channels_select_element.description: response_url_enabled is only valid when used inside an input block within a modal.

overflow_element.description: Must be used inside a section or actions block. Up to 5 options.

rich_text_input_element.description: Must be used inside an input block.

file_input_element.description: Must be used inside an input block in modals only. Requires files:read OAuth scope. 10MB per-file limit (not enforceable in JSON Schema).

image_element.description: Must be used inside a section or context block. Either image_url or slack_file is required. image_width, image_height, image_bytes, and fallback are response-only metadata Slack echoes back on retrieved messages; they are ignored on send but accepted here so real Slack payloads validate.

url_source_element.description: URL source element — only valid inside a task_card block's sources array.

actions_block_element.description: Elements allowed inside an actions block.

section_accessory_element.description: Elements that may appear as the accessory of a section block. datetimepicker is intentionally excluded — docs say it 'must be used inside the actions block or input block'.

input_block_element.description: Elements that may appear as the element of an input block.

context_block_element.description: Elements allowed inside a context block.

context_actions_block_element.description: Elements allowed inside a context_actions block.

rich_text_style_object.description: Style flags for rich-text leaf elements. Slack docs disagree on which flags are allowed per leaf type; this is the union of all flags documented.

rich_text_emoji_leaf.description: Slack's official docs (rich-text-block reference) only list type/name/unicode, but the API silently accepts a `style` object on emoji leaves. We allow it to match observed behavior.

rich_text_leaf.description: Any of the 10 rich-text leaf element kinds.

elements.description: Empty array is accepted by Slack (verified in Block Kit Builder 2026-04-16).
Empty array is accepted by Slack (verified in Block Kit Builder 2026-04-16).
Empty array is accepted by Slack (verified in Block Kit Builder 2026-04-16).

rich_text_container_element.description: Any of the 4 rich-text container kinds usable inside a rich_text block's elements array.

card_block.description: At least one of hero_image, title, actions, or body is required.

container_child_block.description: A block allowed inside a container block's child_blocks array. Slack documents this set as: actions, context, divider, file, header, image, input, rich_text, section, table, video (https://docs.slack.dev/reference/block-kit/blocks/container-block). Notably excludes container itself (no nesting) and message-only chrome like card/carousel/markdown.

container_block.description: A general-purpose wrapper that groups child blocks into a single, optionally collapsible unit with a configurable width. Messages only (https://docs.slack.dev/reference/block-kit/blocks/container-block). default_collapsed only takes effect when is_collapsible is true; the schema rejects default_collapsed: true without is_collapsible: true.

data_visualization_data_point.description: A single point in a chart series: an x-axis label and its numeric value. The label must match one of axis_config.categories (enforced via checkDataVisualizationConsistency). Negative values are permitted — line/bar/area charts render against a zero baseline.

data_visualization_series.description: A named series of data points plotted on a line/bar/area chart. The name drives the chart legend and must be unique across all series in the same chart (enforced via checkDataVisualizationConsistency).

data_visualization_axis_config.description: Axis configuration for cartesian (line/bar/area) charts. categories define the valid x-axis labels and their left-to-right display order.

data_visualization_segment.description: A single slice of a pie chart. value must be greater than 0; Slack derives the displayed percentage from each segment's value as a share of the total.

data_visualization_chart.description: The chart rendered by a data_visualization block. line/bar/area charts use series + axis_config; pie charts use segments.

oneOf.description: Cartesian chart — line, bar, or area. 1–6 series; axis_config required.

data_table_cell.description: A cell inside a data_table_block row. `raw_text` / `raw_number` for simple values, `rich_text` for formatted content. Per https://docs.slack.dev/reference/block-kit/blocks/data-table-block. The docs' per-cell schemas list `properties` without a `required` array; we mirror `table_cell` and require the value-bearing field(s). The rule 'the first (header) row cannot contain rich_text cells' is a row-position constraint JSON Schema can't express and is not enforced here.

data_table_block.description: Rich, interactive table with pagination, sorting, and filtering (https://docs.slack.dev/reference/block-kit/blocks/data-table-block). Distinct from `table_block`, which is a simpler static table. The single-table and aggregate 10,000-character limits are payload-level rules not enforced here. `row_header_column_index` must point at an existing column, a cross-field rule JSON Schema can't check (bounded to 0–19 since a row has at most 20 cells).

rows.description: First row is the header; 2–101 rows total (1 header + 1–100 data rows), 1–20 cells per row.

data_visualization_block.description: Renders data as a line, bar, area, or pie chart. Messages only (https://docs.slack.dev/reference/block-kit/blocks/data-visualization-block). Slack renders at most two data_visualization blocks per message (enforced via the checkDataVisualizationMax helper, since JSON Schema can't count sibling blocks). Two further runtime rules are enforced via checkDataVisualizationConsistency, since they depend on sibling-field values JSON Schema can't compare: series names must be unique within a chart, and each series must contain exactly one data point per axis_config.categories label.

file_block.description: Cannot be added to app surfaces directly; surfaces only when retrieving messages that contain remote files.

image_block.description: Either image_url or slack_file is required (not both). image_width, image_height, image_bytes, is_animated, and fallback are response-only metadata Slack echoes back on retrieved messages; they are ignored on send but accepted here so real Slack payloads validate.

input_block.description: If element is a file_input, dispatch_action must not be true.

markdown_block.description: block_id is ignored on markdown blocks. Cumulative 12,000-char limit across all markdown blocks in one payload is a payload-level rule, not enforced here.

task_card_inline_object.description: A task card as it appears inline within a plan_block tasks array — the docs' example omits the type discriminator.

elements.description: Empty array is accepted by Slack (verified in Block Kit Builder 2026-04-16).

section_block.description: Must have text or fields (or both).

table_cell.description: A cell inside a table_block row. Either raw_text or rich_text.

elements.description: Empty array is accepted by Slack (verified in Block Kit Builder 2026-04-16).

table_column_setting.description: Per-column settings inside table_block.column_settings. May be null to skip.

table_block.description: One table per message (server-enforced via invalid_attachments / only_one_table_allowed). Up to 100 rows, up to 20 cells per row.

task_card_block.description: Standalone task_card block (also embeddable inline within plan_block).

video_block.description: Requires links.embed:write OAuth scope. video_url must be in app's unfurl domains, HTTPS, embeddable, return 2xx, not point to Slack-related domains.

block.description: Discriminated union of every Block Kit block type.

modal_view.description: Modal view surface (views.open / views.push / views.update payload). title/submit/close text capped at 24 chars. When blocks contain any input block, submit is required (per docs).
